decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.24 Review Plan CLI for release.
rationale: Visionary: review-plan turns QIF discovery surfaces into a reviewer-ready action packet for release, pilot, and governance work. Builder: implementation composes existing status, inventory, release-ready, and open-risk commands without adding external dependencies or a new package type. Guardian: review-plan remains structural review organization only and does not claim semantic truth, independent reviewer agreement, business approval correctness, or operational safety.
recommendation: Release v0.6.24 after final structural checks, residue scan, commit, tag, and GitHub Release.
